text: みんなで　ここまで　およいで　きたけど…　くたびれたわ

structure.jp: ここまで　およいで　きたけど…
structure.en: we swam all the way here, but...

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くる says you did the action on the way to where you are now. およいで　きた = 'came here swimming'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two statements with 'but'. きたけど = 'we came, but'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a word for people says they do it as a group. みんなで = 'all together'.
